rationale.conceptual: The method is an established lattice-gas model in the quasichemical approximation applied to spherical geometry with three dividing-surface conventions. Implementing the self-consistent layer equations and computing correct total free energies and masses requires understanding of statistical thermodynamics and careful numerical treatment of interfacial profiles. It is a multi-part documented algorithm but not a novel, research-grade derivation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves only two steps (generate energies and generate local properties) with a simple parameter sweep over temperature, radius, and dividing surfaces. All dependencies are standard Python libraries, no external tooling or data acquisition, and output is just CSV files.
